headline: US futures point to a higher open as Nvidia earnings boost tech ahead of housing data, EIA report and FOMC minutes
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) are up 0.62%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) are up 1.18%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) are up 0.28%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) are up 0.12%, indicating a gap higher at the open
- Nvidia (NVDA) trades higher pre-market after a post-close earnings beat and raised guidance, with revenue up 103% year-over-year to $115.8 billion, exceeding estimates
- AI and chip names including Micron (MU), Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), and Marvell Technology (MRVL) gain alongside neocloud play CoreWeave (CRWV), which climbs over 6%
- Samsung downplays concerns about an AI bubble, while the anticipated Anthropic IPO is expected to test investor appetite for the AI sector
- Retailers Target (TGT), Lowe’s (LOW), and TJX Companies (TJX) are scheduled to report earnings before the bell, setting up potential swing trades based on results versus consensus
- Palo Alto Networks (PANW) is due to report earnings after the close, adding to today’s tech-heavy catalyst calendar
- Bumble (BMBL) appears on technical watch lists for a potential pocket pivot setup
- US housing starts and building permits data are due at 8:30 AM ET, with pending home sales at 10:00 AM ET
- EIA crude oil (@CL) inventory data are scheduled for 10:30 AM ET, followed by FOMC minutes at 2:00 PM ET as key macro catalysts
- Oil and gold (@GC) prices declined in overnight trading, shaping the backdrop for today’s session alongside earnings reactions and Fed policy minutes
